user.title: User
user.description: User profile with role-based access control and admin approval status

approvedAt.description: Timestamp when approved by an admin

device.title: Device
device.description: Registered ESP32 climate monitoring device directly assigned to an active driver

assignedDriverUid.description: UID of the active assigned driver, or null if unassigned

active.description: Whether device is enabled and active

lastSeenAt.description: Timestamp of most recent heartbeat or reading

lastReadingAt.description: Timestamp of most recent valid sensor reading

latestTemperatureC.description: Latest reported temperature in degrees Celsius

latestHumidityRH.description: Latest reported relative humidity in % RH

desiredConfigVersion.description: Target configuration version set by admin

lastErrorCode.description: Diagnostic error code if sensor fault

deviceConfig.title: DeviceConfig
deviceConfig.description: Per-device automation parameters and manual fan override instructions

temperatureOnC.description: Temperature threshold to turn fan ON in degrees Celsius

temperatureOffC.description: Temperature threshold to turn fan OFF in degrees Celsius (must be < On threshold)

humidityOnRH.description: Humidity threshold to turn fan ON in % RH

humidityOffRH.description: Humidity threshold to turn fan OFF in % RH (must be < On threshold)

activationMode.description: Logic condition for triggering fan (ANY = temp OR humidity, ALL = temp AND humidity)

fanControlEnabled.description: Firmware hardware automation flag for cooling fan

mistControlEnabled.description: Firmware hardware automation flag for humidifiers

overrideExpiresAt.description: Timestamp when manual override expires and device reverts to AUTO

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the configuration

deviceReading.title: DeviceReading
deviceReading.description: Historical time-series sample of DHT11 temperature, humidity, and fan relay telemetry

sensorHealthy.description: Whether DHT11 checksum and bus communication succeeded

deviceRecordedAt.description: Timestamp recorded by ESP32 internal clock

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: System event notification for threshold excursion, sensor failure, or connectivity loss

assignedDriverUidAtCreation.description: UID of assigned driver when alert triggered

acknowledged.description: Whether admin has acknowledged the alert

acknowledgedBy.description: UID of admin who acknowledged the alert

auditLog.title: AuditLog
auditLog.description: Immutable administrative audit record for privileged security actions

actorUid.description: UID of the user or system component performing the action

actorRole.description: Role of the actor at time of action

action.description: Audit event type (e.g. USER_APPROVED, DEVICE_ASSIGNED, FAN_OVERRIDE)

targetType.description: Type of resource targeted (e.g. DEVICE, USER, CONFIG)

details.description: Contextual details or JSON metadata about the change

/users/{userId}.description: User account profiles and approval states

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered ESP32 climate monitors and live summary states

/devices/{deviceId}/config/current.description: Current active climate automation thresholds and fan modes

/devices/{deviceId}/readings/{readingId}.description: Time-series DHT11 readings and relay status records

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable security and administrative audit trail
